Appreciate the numbers, Alex — that helps a lot. Friday 10am PT works for us; I’ve booked a 60-min slot and invited your dev-ops.

Quick answers to your infra questions: 
1) Dedup window: yes — we can configure shorter dedup windows per-customer. 1 hour is fine; we’ll note that in the MOP for Dedicated or Private deployments.
2) Retry and IDs: keep X-Request-Id constant for a given user transaction to make tracing easier. Idempotency-Key should stay the same across retries for mutating calls so the server can dedupe; for strictly idempotent read-style calls you can omit Idempotency-Key.
3) Retry-After: we return seconds (integer).

I’ve attached the SLA datasheet and added a short mutual action plan in the calendar invite. Next steps: please confirm attendee list for Friday and share any internal firewall egress rules we should know about.

Thanks,
Ben

Hi all — prepping for our Friday session. Attaching a short integration playbook and pasting a few concrete defaults we typically recommend so your team can validate quickly. Attachment: integration-playbook.md

Defaults we recommend (can be tuned):
- Per-API-key steady QPS: provision 500 QPS for your baseline (we can reserve Dedicated capacity for guaranteed throughput).
- Burst handling: enable token-bucket smoothing client-side with a local queue; server will allow short bursts based on capacity and routing policy.
- Retry policy (recommended):
  * attempts: 5
  * backoff: base=200ms, multiplier=2, max=10s, jitter=0.25
  * honor Retry-After header first if present
- Idempotency storage window: configurable; start with 1h for your test environment, 24h for production unless you have retention constraints.

Example HTTP headers we surface: 
- X-Request-Id: 9f1b2e7a-... (string)
- Idempotency-Key: acme-transaction-20260728-0001
- X-RateLimit-Limit: 500
- X-RateLimit-Remaining: 498
- X-RateLimit-Reset: 1627512000

Embeddings guidance:
- Batch up to 256 short texts per request to improve throughput; watch memory on client side.
- If doing reranking, send candidate IDs with precomputed embeddings to the rerank endpoint to avoid N*M calls.

Tool-calling / structured output:
- When using tool-calling, include a schema in the prompt and validate on the client with the SDK. If you need strict verification, route outputs through our struct validator microservice.

If you want, I can post these code snippets to the shared drive link before the call. See you Friday.

Cheers,
